conventions.github_accelerator_rule: For GitHub release assets and raw.githubusercontent.com URLs, replace the original host with the accelerator host. Keep normal github.com for GitHub API and git clone unless the user says otherwise.
conventions.windows_shell_note: On Windows automation, prefer .cmd launchers for node-family tools: npm.cmd, npx.cmd, pnpm.cmd, bun.cmd. PowerShell .ps1 shims work interactively but some external launchers only handle .cmd.
conventions.git_bash_note: Get-Command bash resolves to C:\WINDOWS\system32\bash.exe (WSL/Windows launcher), not Git Bash. Use C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe for Git Bash.
conventions.tshark_note: TShark was installed without Npcap. It can parse offline pcap/pcapng files but cannot do native live capture. Use Reqable for live traffic.
conventions.rea_note: REA MCP is disabled by default. Connect/disconnect temporarily through the OpenCode experimental MCP API. Do not run rea-agents setup --client; skill-only updates are safe.
conventions.java_home_note: Process JAVA_HOME is C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-17, but rea-mcp.cmd overrides JAVA_HOME to the winget-installed Microsoft JDK 25 at C:\Program Files\Microsoft\jdk-25.0.5.102-hotspot, required by Ghidra 12.2.
conventions.java_alias_note: Prefer non-versioned Java junctions when a path is needed: C:\Program Files\Java\latest\jdk-21, C:\Program Files\Java\latest\jre-1.8, C:\Program Files (x86)\Java\latest\jre-1.8, and C:\Program Files (x86)\Common Files\Oracle\Java\java8path. They track the installed patch version automatically; JDK 17 and Zulu 11 paths are already version-free.
conventions.encoding_note: rea-mcp.cmd is GBK/CP936 with CRLF and no BOM. This toolchain JSON/Markdown is UTF-8 no BOM.

config_facts.title: Python is uv-managed; no global python/pip
config_facts.value: uv run python script.py  |  uvx <tool>  |  uv tool install <tool>
config_facts.usage: Do not assume `python`, `python3`, or `pip` are on PATH. They are absent. Use uv run python <file>.py for scripts, uvx <tool> for one-off tool CLIs, and uv tool install <tool> for reusable tool commands.
config_facts.notes: uv-managed CPython 3.12.15 installed under C:\Users\guyue\AppData\Roaming\uv\python; uv also exposes C:\Users\guyue\.local\bin\python3.12.exe. uv pip is only for active virtual environments.

config_facts.usage: Git clone/fetch already use the local proxy. core.editor is VS Code with --wait. GitHub and Gist credentials use gh.exe auth git-credential.

config_facts.title: GitHub CLI

config_facts.usage: Prefer winget first, then Chocolatey, then an official ZIP from the vendor/accelerated GitHub release.
